protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: replace_first uses JavaScript string-replacement semantics, so attacker-controlled $& expands to the matched input; chaining it causes exponential allocation, and the later memoryLimit accounting charges inputs rather than the expanded result. The sibling replace and replace_last implementations do not provide this replacement-pattern amplification path.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: bounded all-ref -S history identifies 4595e2872e7800b93b0d6e487430431a0402f0b2 as the first implementation of replace_first, registered as lodash 4.13.1 _.replace. Later native-replace rewrites, TypeScript/file moves, and the 2024 limiter wrapper preserve rather than originate the replacement-pattern behavior.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: the BIC has immediate parent b478c798fdd5aba96b1fa279dd78410d4844584c. The parent tree has no replace_first implementation; its only replace_first occurrence is an unchecked README TODO.

It is therefore the smallest surviving first-write object in the available public history.
